title: MEMO_RETURN mapped to to_muxed_id bytes, the same as MEMO_HASH
pattern: CAP-0067 renders MEMO_RETURN in the transfer event as bytes, exactly as MEMO_HASH: from the event alone the two cannot be told apart.

hazards.placement: MEMO_RETURN carried into the transfer event as to_muxed_id (bytes), indistinguishable from MEMO_HASH

facts.says: The transfer event carries the same 32 bytes as to_muxed_id bytes.
